title: Coordinated movements
instructions: Spread all the participating players out at even intervals, facing one side of the court in the defensive stance. title: Rondo Drill
instructions: Setup: Create a small circle or square grid (about 5-7 meters in diameter). Place 4-6 players around the outside of the grid and 1-2 players inside the grid as defenders. Instructions: The players on the outside pass the ball to each other, trying to maintain possession. The defenders inside the grid try to intercept the ball or force a mistake. If a defender wins the ball or forces it out of bounds, they switch places with the player who lost possession. The objective for the outside players is to complete as many passes as possible without losing the ball. Coaching Points: Emphasize quick, accurate passes. Encourage players to use one or two touches to keep the ball moving. Players should communicate and call for the ball. Focus on good body positioning to receive the ball and make the next pass. Encourage players to keep their heads up and be aware of the defenders' positions. Variations: Increase or decrease the number of defenders to adjust the difficulty.
